dialogues.speaker: Rama
dialogues.text: Spices are essential for us Sumeru cooks!

dialogues.speaker: Rama
dialogues.text: As a vendor of everyday spices, I can't be more clear about this.

dialogues.speaker: Rama
dialogues.text: People buy more Spice from me than other seasonings combined together!

dialogues.speaker: Rama
dialogues.text: Even the most ordinary recipe can be given a new lease on life with the addition of Sumeru's unique Spice!
